identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase I Clinical Study of Anti-CD19 CAR-T Therapy (pCAR-19B) in the Treatment of CD19-positive Relapsed/Refractory B-ALL

descriptionModule.detailedDescription: This is a single-center, single-arm, open-label study. The study plans to set up 3 dose groups, adopting a dose-escalating 3+3 design, and plan to recruit about 9-18 subjects with relapsed or refractory B-ALL.pCAR-19B will be infused to the subject by intravenous infusion.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Incidence of Adverse events after pCAR-19B infusion [Safety and Tolerability]
primaryOutcomes.description: Therapy-related adverse events were recorded and assessed according to the National Cancer Institute's Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE, Version 5.0)

primaryOutcomes.measure: Obtain the maximum tolerated dose of pCAR-19B cells[Safety and Tolerability]

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Objective response rate after pCAR-19B infusion [Effectiveness]
secondaryOutcomes.description: Objective response rate includes CR, CRi
AUCS is defined as the area under the curve in 28 days and 90 days
CMAX is defined as the highest concentration of pCAR-19B cells expanded in peripheral blood
TMAX is defined as the time to reach the highest concentration
Cytokines such as hs-CRP, IL-6 levels
